title: arxmcp.bridge/evidence-bundle v0.2 (WS-D-authored content for the WS-C stub)
description: Every proving run emits exactly one EvidenceBundle (AC-D.13); verdict-award rules are a pure function over the bundle, and no component can emit 'proved' free-text without a taxonomy tag. v0.2 authors the payload content for the v0.1 PLACEMENT STUB hosted on stage2/arx-c1 contracts/ (IF-5 custody split: WS-C hosts + versions, WS-D authors). The v0.1 pins are preserved unchanged: task_id + verdict required; the D9 five-verdict enum (append-only within a MAJOR; abstained is the structural default). New at v0.2: verdict 'refuted' REQUIRES a counterexample artifact (AC-D.7 FALSE-must-reject contract); cas artifacts carry the AC-D.11 replay floor (code + params + timeout recorded); the skeptic block pins prover_cycles to the const 0 (AC-D.10 counterexample-FIRST — the lane runs before any prover cycle, and the bundle's own budget accounting proves it). The faithfulness block is CLOSED at v0.2 by the D-3 gate authored in the same slice (server/proving/faithfulness.py): dual independent formalizations + Lean equivalence + blind back-translation diff + human sign-off (AC-D.5), with two bundle-level laws — verdict 'proven-formal' REQUIRES a faithfulness record, and a publishable proven-formal bundle REQUIRES human_signoff.signed=true (no automation may set it; server.proving.faithfulness.record_human_signoff is the only signer and is operator-invoked). Truth-values inside the record (established, match, attestations) are award-rule territory (server.proving.faithfulness.faithfulness_award_ok), not schema territory, so failed gates remain honestly recordable. Custody note: this file lives under server/proving/schemas/ ONLY until the Stage-2 integration step moves it into contracts/ per IF-5 (see server/proving/README.md).

verdict.description: D9 five-verdict taxonomy (v0.1 pin). Append-only within a MAJOR. abstained is the structural default; confidence derives from evidence tier attained, never model self-report.

verdict_reasons.description: Machine-readable award/denial trail (e.g. the formal_award_ok denial reasons).

escalated.description: True when the standing escalation rules fired (any proven-* on a FALSE/OPEN control, AC-D.9; conflicting evidence, AC-D.12).

counterexample.description: REQUIRED when verdict is 'refuted' (AC-D.7). kernel_confirmed=true only for a Lean-witness snippet that is kernel-accepted and soundness-clean (server.kat.witness_ok + sorry-taint scan); search-tactic and CAS hits are recorded with kernel_confirmed=false.

source.description: Append-only enum within the MAJOR. 'literature' covers the L4 no-explicit-counterexample humility path (e.g. Mertens).

witness.description: The witness data itself (bindings, numeric value, citation record...). Null when the source carries no explicit witness.

skeptic.description: The D-5 counterexample-first lane record. prover_cycles is const 0: the lane runs BEFORE any prover cycle by contract, and this block is the budget-accounting proof (AC-D.10).

checks.description: One structured record per executed check, in execution order. Checks after a short-circuiting hit are not listed.

cas_refused.description: True when CAS checks were requested but the runner refused because ARXMCP_ENABLE_SKEPTIC_CAS is off (default).

formal.description: Formal-lane evidence: the hardened lean_verify result grain (soundness + provenance blocks; the award predicate is server.lean_soundness.formal_award_ok). Open at v0.

faithfulness.description: D-3 statement-faithfulness gate record (AC-D.5), closed shape authored by server/proving/faithfulness.py (gate_version 1). Presence + shape are schema law; the TRUTH of the elements (independence attestations hold, equivalence established via lean-iff with both directions passing the hardened formal award, back-translation blind and matching, sign-off signed) is re-derived fail-closed by the pure award rule faithfulness_award_ok — a bundle missing or failing any element caps at plausible-unverified (AC-D.5). Failed gates are deliberately recordable here (no const-pinned attestation values outside the publishable law above).

dual.description: Exactly two independent formalization passes ('dual' is the contract, not 'n-way'): distinct channels A/B, distinct sessions, neither saw the other's output. Attestation values are typed boolean (not const) so violations remain recordable; the award rule fails them.

equivalence.description: Kernel-checked equivalence of the two formalizations: one obligation per direction through the D-2 hardened lean_verify, each direction award-eligible only when formal_award_ok passes. Only method 'lean-iff' is award-eligible; 'syntactic-identity' is reserved (documented-defeq path, not emitted by gate v1); 'none' records a not-attempted/failed check.

back_translation.description: Blind Lean→English rendering: the translator has NOT seen the original claim (translator_saw_original false, session distinct from both formalizer sessions) and rendered exactly the recorded channel statement. Null when the gate ran without one (recordable failure).

skeptic_diff.description: The skeptic's diff of the blind back-translation against the ORIGINAL claim (the skeptic must have seen the original — that is its job). A 'mismatch' verdict lists its discrepancies.

human_signoff.description: The AC-D.5 human checkbox. run_faithfulness_gate always emits signed=false; record_human_signoff (operator-invoked, never pipeline automation) is the only signer. When signed, by + at are required (also enforced conditionally below).

publishable.description: Whether this bundle backs a publishable claim (an article-destined statement). Absent/false = internal run. A publishable proven-formal bundle REQUIRES faithfulness.human_signoff.signed=true (payload allOf law above) — the brief's 'no publishable proven-formal without the human checkbox' as schema, not convention.

cas.description: CAS/numeric artifacts. AC-D.11 replay floor: every artifact records the executed code, structured params (seeds/ranges), and the timeout, so results replay.

controls.description: Per-run KAT control outcomes (AC-D.8): sampled ids, outcomes, abstention rate, reportability.

provenance.description: Producing-run provenance (orchestrator version, toolchain pins, timestamps). Open at v0.

cost.description: Whole-run budget accounting. For a bundle refuted by the skeptic lane, prover_cycles MUST be 0 (AC-D.10) — enforced by the lane, evidenced here.
